scenario_summary: Customer is reporting an unrecognized charge of $76 and requesting an investigation and potential refund.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Jamal Washington and I'm 80. I noticed a $76 charge on my account from two days ago that I don't recognize. I haven't made any recent purchases that I can think of, though it's possible I forgot about something small. Can you look into it, and if it turns out I really didn't authorize it, can you refund it?

Hello Mr. Washington, I’m sorry to hear you’re concerned about an unexpected charge. I would be happy to look into this for you. To ensure we are looking at the correct account, could you please confirm your full mailing address and the last four digits of the phone number associated with your profile?
Sure, I live at 422 Oak Street, Springfield, and my phone number ends in 4492.

Thank you, Mr. Washington. I have successfully verified your account. I see the transaction you are referring to: a $76.00 charge from 'Global Tech Services' dated two days ago. Does that merchant name sound familiar to you at all?
No, that doesn't sound familiar. I don't buy anything from tech companies.

I understand. Under our Fraud Protection Policy, if a transaction is unauthorized, we are required to secure the account immediately. Since this merchant is not recognized, I have initiated a formal dispute for this $76.00 charge. I have also placed a temporary block on your current card to prevent further unauthorized activity and have ordered a replacement to be sent to your address.
Oh, that sounds serious. Will I get my money back?

Yes, per our policy, I have issued a provisional credit for the $76.00 to your account, which will appear within 24 hours while the dispute investigation is finalized. You will not be held liable for this unauthorized transaction. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?

resolution_summary: The agent verified the customer, confirmed the unrecognized charge, initiated a formal dispute, blocked the compromised card, and issued a provisional credit.

judge_scores.justification: The agent conducted appropriate verification and maintained a warm, respectful tone tailored to the customer's situation. They efficiently resolved the issue within their authority by initiating a formal dispute, securing the account, and issuing a provisional credit while citing clear fraud and dispute policies.
